command: Implement proc_packet readback of the metadata-selected Gaussian output blocks, then run taskset -c 8-25 work/generated/l2_aha_garnet_4x16/obj_gaussian_resetedge/Vtb_aha_garnet_gaussian_transcript and compare the readback against the pinned upstream golden bytes.
success_condition: The actual Garnet top accepts the post-PCFG input transcript, finishes the official stream sequence, and every output byte matches the upstream Gaussian golden without a timeout, protocol error, or dropped packet.
failure_policy: Preserve the verified PCFG transcript. Locate the first divergent output block, control interrupt, or proc-packet transaction; do not bypass Garnet with nested Interconnect ports or alter official packet/AXI values.
